enabled.description: Whether the opensnitchd daemon is active on boot

pidfile.description: Path to write the daemon PID file

log_file.description: Path to log file (empty or null to log only to stdout)

socket_path.description: Unix socket endpoint for GUI communication

enable_grpc.description: Enable gRPC API server for GUI and remote management

default_action.description: Global fallback action when no rule matches a connection

enable_stats.description: Collect statistics (e.g., bytes transferred, rule hits)

stats_path.description: Path to the SQLite database for stats and rules

notifications_enabled.description: Show desktop notifications for new connection events

notification_timeout.description: Seconds before a notification auto-closes (if no user interaction)

db_compact.description: Automatically compact the database to reclaim space

db_compact_after_days.description: Days of inactivity before compacting the database

prompt_system_processes.description: Prompt user for rules for connections initiated by system processes

prompt_inbound.description: Prompt for rules on inbound connections

prompt_localhost.description: Prompt for rules on localhost traffic

local_procs.description: List of local process names (without path) to exclude from prompting

outbound_local_procs.description: Deprecated; kept for compatibility. Prefer local_procs.

dns_lookup.description: Resolve remote IP addresses to hostnames in alerts

custom_ca_bundle.description: Optional path to custom CA certificate bundle (PEM format) for TLS verification

grpc_use_tls.description: Enable TLS on the gRPC server (required for remote access)

grpc_tls_cert.description: Path to server TLS certificate for gRPC (PEM)

grpc_tls_key.description: Path to server TLS private key for gRPC

grpc_verify_client.description: Require client certificate authentication for gRPC

grpc_client_ca_cert.description: CA certificate for verifying client certificates (if grpc_verify_client=true)

ui.description: User Interface gRPC server settings (used by opensnitch-ui)

server_address.description: Address (IP:port) where the UI gRPC server listens

use_tls.description: Enable TLS for UI gRPC server

server_cert.description: Path to UI gRPC TLS certificate

server_key.description: Path to UI gRPC TLS private key

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain rule statistics before purging

system_process_enabled.description: Show notifications for system process connections

auto_allow_timeout_ms.description: If nonzero, automatically allows connections after this many milliseconds if no user action (0 = disable)
